mapper.delete: delete from sys_user where user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

mapper.select: select a.user_id, a.user_name, a.PASSWORD, a.true_name, a.user_type, a.sex, a.e_mail, a.mobile_phone, a.work_no, a.face_id, a.finger_id, a.voice_id, a.state, a.user_title, a.creator_id, a.appkey, a.image_url, a.role_id, a.org_id, a.user_status, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.invalid_time, a.last_login from sys_user a where 1 = 1 and a.user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} limit 1

SELECT b.user_id, a.org_name, a.org_code, a.up_id, a.sort, a.create_time, a.creator_id, a.org_level, a.org_path, a.dept_name FROM sys_org a LEFT JOIN sys_user b ON a.org_id = b.org_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND b.user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT c.menu_code AS menuCode FROM sys_user a LEFT JOIN sys_role b ON a.role_id = b.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu c ON c.role_id = b.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_menu d ON c.menu_code = d.menu_code WHERE user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT c.region_id AS Id,d.region_name AS label,d.up_region_id AS upId,"region" AS infoType FROM sys_user a LEFT JOIN sys_role b ON a.role_id = b.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_role_region c ON b.role_id = c.role_id LEFT JOIN t_std_region d ON c.region_id = d.region_id WHERE user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} UNION ALL (SELECT DISTINCT c.device_id AS Id,d.device_name AS label,d.up_region_id AS upId,"device" AS infoType FROM sys_user a LEFT JOIN sys_role b ON a.role_id = b.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_role_device c ON b.role_id = c.role_id LEFT JOIN t_std_device d ON c.device_id = d.device_id WHERE user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT}) UNION ALL (SELECT d.custom_id AS Id,d.custom_name AS label,d.device_id AS upId,"custom" AS infoType FROM sys_user a LEFT JOIN sys_role b ON a.role_id = b.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_role_device c ON b.role_id = c.role_id LEFT JOIN t_std_device d ON c.device_id = d.device_id WHERE user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT}) UNION ALL (SELECT DISTINCT c.camera_id AS Id,d.camera_name AS label,d.up_region_id AS upId,"camera" AS infoType FROM sys_user a LEFT JOIN sys_role b ON a.role_id = b.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_role_camera c ON b.role_id = c.role_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_info d ON c.camera_id = d.camera_id WHERE user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT})

select a.user_id,a.user_name,a.PASSWORD,a.true_name,a.user_type,a.sex,a.e_mail,a.mobile_phone,a.work_no,a.face_id,a.finger_id,a.voice_id, a.state,a.user_title,a.creator_id,a.appkey,a.image_url,a.role_id,b.role_name,a.org_id,c.org_name,a.user_status,a.create_time,a.update_time,a.invalid_time,a.last_login from sys_user a LEFT JOIN sys_role b ON a.role_id = b.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_org c ON c.org_id = a.org_id where 1 = 1 and a.user_name = #{userName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.PASSWORD = #{password, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
